newsitem.title: USA: Carnival eyeing China stop for cruise stop.
newsitem.headline: Carnival eyeing China stop for cruise stop.

text.p: Carnival Corp chairman Micky Arison said on Monday the company may include a port of call in China for the Carnival Cruise ship it will assign to Korea next year in a joint venture with Hyundai Corp

Carnival will base its 1,000-passenger Carnival Tropical next spring in Korea to serve the Asian holiday market. Japan and Korea will be key targets for the 50-50 joint venture between the companies, Arison told the company's annual shareholders meeting.
"It's going to be western-style for the Asian market," Arison said.
Carnival will translate menus, add regional cuisine, and make announcements in Asian languages but will also feature a country-and-western themed night of entertainment on the cruises, Arison said.
Arison gave no details on which port in China Carnival may choose and did not say when a decision might be made.
